title: Goldman Sachs reportedly selected to lead SpaceX IPO in landmark Wall Street deal
title_zh: 据报道，高盛选择在具有里程碑意义的华尔街交易中牵头 SpaceX IPO
summary: Goldman Sachs has reportedly secured the leading underwriting role for SpaceX’s expected stock market debut this year in a move that paves the way for the largest IPO in history.View on euronews
summary_zh: 据报道，高盛已获得 SpaceX 预计今年首次上市的主要承销角色，此举为历史上最大规模的 IPO 铺平了道路。

title: Citi Lowers Target on Salesforce (CRM) Over Slower Deal Activity
title_zh: 由于交易活动放缓，花旗降低了 Salesforce (CRM) 目标
summary: Ray Dalio ranks among the richest hedge fund managers in the world. Although NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) remains the billionaire’s largest position, Salesforce Inc. (NYSE:CRM) ranks 5th on the list of Ray Dalio’s top holdings with a 1.87% portfolio share.
summary_zh: 雷·达里奥 (Ray Dalio) 跻身全球最富有的对冲基金经理之列。尽管 NVIDIA Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）仍然是这位亿万富翁的最大持股，但 Salesforce Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）在 Ray Dalio 持股最多的...

title: A Look At Diversified Energy’s Valuation As Oklahoma Asset Deal With Carlyle Expands Its Portfolio
title_zh: 随着俄克拉荷马州资产交易与凯雷扩大其投资组合，多元化能源的估值一览
summary: Diversified Energy (DEC) has drawn fresh attention after reaching an agreement with Carlyle to acquire additional oil and gas assets in Oklahoma using asset backed financing, while reporting higher first quarter production and reaffirming 2026 output guidance.
summary_zh: 多元化能源公司 (DEC) 与凯雷达成协议，利用资产支持融资收购俄克拉荷马州的更多石油和天然气资产，同时公布第一季度产量增加并重申 2026 年产量指引，引发了新的关注。

title: Target the Red-Hot Spin-Off and Merger Space With These ETFs
title_zh: 通过这些 ETF 瞄准炙手可热的分拆和合并空间
summary: Spin-offs and mergers can lead to major movement for share prices, but accessing these scenarios can be challenging for investors; these ETFs can help.
summary_zh: 分拆和合并可能会导致股价大幅波动，但了解这些情况对投资者来说可能具有挑战性；这些 ETF 可以提供帮助。
